name: RayCursor
summary: Raycasting with a cursor that the user can move along the ray, plus a semi-automatic mode that snaps to the nearest target.
howItWorks: A cursor sits on the ray. The user slides it in depth with a touchpad to reach targets at any distance, including behind others; in the semi-automatic variant the cursor is placed on the target closest to the ray and highlighted before confirmation.

relationships.note: Adds a depth cursor on the ray, as Depth Ray does.
